name: desktop-cat
description: 3D desktop pet cat - stage 0 tech spike

scripts.build: esbuild --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome120 --loader:.glb=binary src/renderer/boot.ts --outfile=dist/renderer.js && esbuild --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome120 --loader:.glb=binary src/studio/boot.ts --outfile=dist/studio.js && esbuild --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome120 --loader:.glb=binary src/tree/boot.ts --outfile=dist/tree.js
scripts.start: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
scripts.studio: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron . --studio
